calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 5
ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = '2026-10-07'

SELECT MIN(calendar_date) as earliest_date, MAX(calendar_date) as latest_date
FROM dim_date

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year >= 'FY2024/25'
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-09-25' AND calendar_date <= '2026-10-04'
ORDER BY calendar_date

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
